concepts.name: Pip
concepts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied mascot image into a new SD Worx brand-color edition. Preserve this exact character identity, facial features, expression, silhouette, pose, props, proportions, crisp 2D cartoon drawing style, and full-body framing. Change its designed palette to the CURRENT SD Worx official logo colors: saturated blue #006DD8, vivid red #F1002F, golden yellow #FFBE00; support with near-white #FBFCFC, pale blue #D9F1FF and dark charcoal #212223 for legible outlines. The colored surfaces should unmistakably be those bright blue/red/yellow brand colors, not the original indigo/purple/lavender. Natural skin tones and natural human hair stay unchanged. Controlled cel shading may use darker and lighter variants of the specified hues. Single static mascot centered on a square canvas with actual alpha transparency, all limbs and props visible and clear margins. No background, no ground shadow, no lettering, no watermark, no UI frame, no new accessories. Exactly one character. Do not add a wordmark or invent an SD Worx logo. Transparent pixels must remain truly transparent.
Specific color placement: Recolor Pip's sweater vest to SD Worx blue #006DD8, bow tie to red #F1002F, folder to yellow #FFBE00 with cream pages, glasses to charcoal #212223, trousers and shoes charcoal with subtle blue accents. Keep cream shirt, brown hair and peach skin.
